title: A colleague's late invoices causing fees
prompt:
You work on the accounts payable team at a mid-sized company. You have noticed that your colleague Anna, who is also a good friend, has been entering supplier invoices several days late. As a result, the company has paid late-payment fees twice this month. Your supervisor has started asking why the fees are happening, and the quarter-end review is in two weeks.

Choose ONE of the following options:

Option A: Talk to Anna. Tell her what you have noticed and encourage her to deal with the problem.

Option B: Talk to your supervisor. Explain what you have noticed and suggest a fair way to handle the situation.
structure: Open politely + link to the supervisor's question about the fees
State the facts you have noticed (neutral, specific, no blame)
Give fair context about your colleague
Suggest 1–2 practical solutions focused on the process
modelAnswer:
Hi Robert, thanks for making time to see me. I wanted to talk about the late fees you asked about last week, because I think I may know what's causing them.

I've noticed that some supplier invoices have been entered three or four days after we receive them. A few of those suppliers have strict payment terms, so even a short delay triggers a penalty. I'm bringing it up now because I don't want it to become a bigger issue at the quarter-end review.

Now, I want to be fair here. It's mostly been Anna's batches, but she's been covering two extra vendors since Carlos left, and I honestly think she's overloaded rather than careless. So, instead of treating this as a performance problem, could we look at the workload? Maybe we could split the high-volume vendors between the three of us, or set up a shared tracker that flags invoices due within five days.

I'd be happy to help set that up if it works for you.

usefulExpressions.expression: I think I may know what's causing them.
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Giới thiệu vấn đề một cách thận trọng, không khẳng định quá mức.

usefulExpressions.expression: I'm bringing it up now because…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'bring up' = nêu ra; giải thích lý do bạn lên tiếng.

usefulExpressions.expression: Now, I want to be fair here.
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Chuyển sang phần bảo vệ đồng nghiệp — thể hiện sự chín chắn và công bằng.
So sánh hai nguyên nhân để định hướng cách giải quyết tích cực.

usefulExpressions.expression: instead of treating this as…, could we…?
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Đề xuất cách tiếp cận khác một cách lịch sự với cấp trên.
Chủ động đề nghị giúp đỡ, kết thúc mang tính xây dựng.

commonMistakes: Đổ lỗi trực tiếp cho đồng nghiệp ('Anna is lazy'). Với cấp trên, hãy nói sự thật trung lập và tập trung vào giải pháp quy trình.
Mở đầu bằng 'I choose option B'. Giám khảo muốn bạn nói chuyện trực tiếp với người được chọn ngay từ đầu.
Dùng sai thì: 'She enters invoices late since March' → 'She has been entering invoices late since March'.

review.notes: Independent review: Checked option B spoken directly to the supervisor, neutral fact-based tone, fair context about Anna, process-focused solution, length (~168). No changes needed.
